_comment: Optional host tool-hook wiring for demo mode. Merge the `hooks` block into
the host's .claude/settings.json (or settings.local.json) in the repository the
`<framework-dir>` in the command below is this framework directory's real name --
`.claude` in the framework's own checkout -- and must be substituted before the hook will run. To skip that step, let
--print-hook` prints this same block with the path already filled in.
Every tool call the host makes is posted to `framework_runtime.py demo --hook`, which
reads runs/.active-demo and appends one `tool_invocation` marker to the recording run;
when no demo run is active it exits 0 without writing anything, so the hook is inert
outside a demo. The matcher is intentionally broad: the demo shows the shape of the
work, and the recorder stores only tool names and an excerpt of each target, never
file contents. Remove the block to stop capturing tool calls; nothing else depends on it.
